letters.name: אישור ביטוח לאומי
letters.summary: Confirms that your national insurance file is active and lists the benefit categories you're enrolled in.
letters.triageHint: you've just enrolled in national insurance or need to confirm your coverage became active

letters.name: הודעת חוב
letters.summary: Explains that unpaid contributions or a benefit recalculation left an outstanding balance, with payment, instalment, or objection steps.
letters.triageHint: unpaid national insurance contributions or a recalculation created an outstanding balance

letters.name: בקשה להמצאת מסמכים
letters.summary: Requests payslips, identity records, or other proofs so a benefit claim or insurance status can be decided.
letters.triageHint: Bituach Leumi cannot finish a claim or status review until you prove something with documents

letters.name: הודעת דרישה שנתית
letters.summary: An assessment from the Tax Authority of how much you owe (or are owed) for a given tax year, with a payment or appeal deadline.
letters.triageHint: the Tax Authority says you owe money or need to respond about a specific tax year

letters.name: דרישה להוכחת הכנסה
letters.summary: Requests documents that support the income used in a tax assessment, refund review, or credit check.
letters.triageHint: the Tax Authority sees a mismatch or needs more proof for income, credits, or a refund review

letters.name: הודעה על החזר מס
letters.summary: Confirms that the Tax Authority owes you money for a tax year and shows how and when the refund will be paid.
letters.triageHint: the Tax Authority says you overpaid and plans to send money back

letters.name: הודעה לחידוש תעודת זהות
letters.summary: Invites you to renew an expiring ID card and explains the appointment, biometric, payment, and document steps.
letters.triageHint: your ID card is expiring or the Interior Ministry is prompting you to renew it
